description: Give Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot safe access to the software your company already runs. 188 pre-built adapters (Deutsche Bahn, DATEV, weclapp, DHL, Shopware, Personio…) plus any REST, SOAP/WSDL, GraphQL or SQL system as MCP tools, no code. Self-hosted, knowledge graph, per-tool response mapping, OAuth2/RBAC/SSO/audit. Open source under AGPL-3.0.
